facts.text: The hotel is at 2-10-4 Toranomon, Minato-ku, Tokyo.
facts.excerpt: 2-10-4 Toranomon, Minato-ku, Tokyo

facts.text: The Okura has welcomed guests since 1962.
facts.excerpt: since 1962

facts.text: The hotel spans two buildings with different styles: the Prestige Tower and the Heritage Wing.
facts.excerpt: Across two brands and buildings with intriguingly different styles - The Prestige Tower and The Heritage Wing

facts.text: The Heritage Wing lobby has wallpaper from the original Heian banquet room and a vast chandelier inspired by wisteria.
facts.excerpt: Aesthetic details make the Heritage Wing special, like lobby wallpaper from the original Heian banquet room, and the vast chandelier inspired by wisteria

facts.text: The Heritage lobby has a mural honoring the Heian poetry scroll The Thirty-Six Immortals of Poetry.
facts.excerpt: The Heritage lobby has a mural honoring the Heian poetry scroll, The Thirty-Six Immortals of Poetry

facts.text: The Heritage Wing has a traditional Japanese tea ceremony room.
facts.excerpt: Enter the secluded, enchanting atmosphere of a Japanese tea ceremony room and be part of a tradition passed down through the centuries.

facts.text: The Prestige Tower rises 41 stories and pairs the legacy of its grand lobby with ultra-modern design details.
facts.excerpt: Rising 41 stories into the Tokyo sky, the Okura Prestige Tower fuses the noble legacy of its grand lobby with ultra-modern design details

facts.text: Crafted Okura Lanterns create a light and shadow effect in the Prestige lobby.
facts.excerpt: Beautifully crafted Okura Lanterns add to the delicate light and shadow effect in the Prestige lobby

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 37th floor.
facts.excerpt: From 15:00 at the 5th floor front counter or the 37th floor Club Lounge

facts.text: Sazanka is a teppanyaki grill and viewing gallery on the 41st floor.
facts.excerpt: Sazanka is a grill, 41st-floor viewing gallery, and chef's workshop all in one.

facts.text: Yamazato restaurant offers private rooms for traditional Japanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Book a private room at Yamazato restaurant and treat yourself and your companions to the very best of traditional Japanese cuisine and hospitality.

facts.text: Okura experiences include tours of the historic lobby, traditional tea ceremonies and the Okura Museum of Art.
facts.excerpt: Okura experiences include tours of the historic lobby, traditional tea ceremonies, and Okura museum of Art.

facts.text: Okura Fitness and Spa has a gym with skyline views, a pool and spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Work out in our gym with skyline views, then cool off in the 25-meter pool or indulge in a spa treatment

facts.text: All Heritage rooms are junior suites or suites, each with a private steam sauna and jet bath.
facts.excerpt: all Heritage rooms are junior suites or suites. Indulge in your private steam sauna and jet bath

facts.text: Heritage Rooms have oak walls and traditional andon lanterns.
facts.excerpt: Your Heritage Room epitomizes Japanese finesse, from the oak walls to the traditional andon lanterns.

facts.text: Heritage Rooms have an engawa bench evoking classical Japanese homes.
facts.excerpt: There's also an engawa bench evoking classical Japanese homes.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private garden, original artwork and a deep soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: A private garden, original artwork, and a deep soaking tub make the Presidential Suite unique

facts.text: The Imperial Suite has three bedrooms on the top two floors of the Prestige Tower.
facts.excerpt: With three bedrooms on the top two floors of the Prestige Tower, the Imperial Suite is an experience of its own.

facts.text: The Imperial Suite has a home theater, a workout room, and dry and steam saunas.
facts.excerpt: a home theater and a workout room, as well as dry and steam saunas

facts.text: The Imperial Suite is one of the largest suites in Japan.
facts.excerpt: it's one of the largest across all of Japan

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a living-dining room and an onsen-style tub.
facts.excerpt: With a living-dining room and an onsen-style tub

facts.text: From Prestige Corner rooms guests can pick out sights like the Imperial Palace and the three skyscrapers of Azabudai Hills.
facts.excerpt: Gaze out through large windows and pick out sights like the Imperial Palace and the three skyscrapers of Azabudai Hills

facts.text: In Prestige Rooms the deep bathtub sits beside a picture window looking over the city.
facts.excerpt: Your deep bathtub sits beside a picture window, inviting you to admire the city while you relax.

facts.text: Guests get free admission to the Okura Museum of Art.
facts.excerpt: Free admission to Okura Museum of Art

facts.text: In the Heritage Wing a complimentary Pierre Marcolini chocolate is left after each turndown.
facts.excerpt: the complimentary Pierre Marcolini chocolate we leave after each turndown in the Heritage Wing

facts.text: Heritage Rooms have toiletry kits from organic spa brand Bamford and Japanese cosmetics brand THREE.
facts.excerpt: Toiletry kits consisting of products from organic spa brand Bamford, Japanese boutique cosmetics brand THREE, and other curated amenities are prepared in each room.

facts.text: Guests staying in the Heritage Wing can use free valet parking.
facts.excerpt: Guests staying in the Heritage Wing can make use of free valet parking services.

facts.text: Heritage Rooms welcome guests with a seasonally inspired welcome drink.
facts.excerpt: On arrival, sit back with a seasonally inspired welcome drink

facts.text: Heritage Suites have steam saunas, wood-furnished living areas and butler boxes.
facts.excerpt: Steam saunas and wood-furnished living areas are your private sanctuaries to relax and unwind, while butler boxes ensure discretion.

facts.text: The hotel says nowhere in the world matches it for bringing Japanese history and design to life.
facts.excerpt: nowhere in the world matches The Okura for bringing the elegance of Japanese history and design to life

facts.text: Okura Fitness and Spa has scheduled inspection and maintenance in 2027.
facts.excerpt: Scheduled Inspection and Maintenance at Okura Fitness & Spa (2027)
